newsitem.title: GHANA: Mideast and African port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Mideast and African port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
GHANA, Nov 26 - Tema, Takoradi - No berthing delays expected.

ISRAEL, Nov 26 - Haifa - Seven vessels due, 1-2 days delay expected. Loading/discharging at berth 4 general cargo, 4 bulk, 4 containers, 1 passenger. Waiting at anchorage to load/discharge 1 bulk, 1 container. 2 Under repair/drydock, 5 awaiting orders. Ashdod - Two to three days delay. Loading/discharging at berth, 10 general cargo, 2 bulk, 3 containers, 2 passenger. Waiting at anchorage to load/discharge 4 general cargo, 1 bulk, 2 containers. Eilat - Loading/discharging at berth 1 bulk, 1 container, 1 passenger.
JORDAN, Nov 23 - Aqaba - Three vessels loading at berth, 8 discharging, 5 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 to discharge, 2 awaiting orders.

MOZAMBIQUE, Nov 25 - Nacala - Port working normally (first come, first served basis). No restriction on berthing and sailing at night. Draft restriction 9.5 metres plus height of tide at general cargo berths and 14 metres at container berths. One tug available. Beira - General cargo berths working normally (first come, first served). Container/other terminals working normally. Pilotage now possible 24 hours a day for vessels up to 140 metres loa with max draft 7.5 metres. Two tugs fully operational. Night navigation for larger vessels restricted and subject to prior arrangements with port captain. Maputo - Pilotage now possible 24 hours a day for vessels up to 120 metres loa with max draft of 9 metres. Two tugs available, one out of order. Night navigation for larger vessels restricted and subject to prior arrangements with port captain. All berths working normally and expected to remain so (first come, first served. Draft restriction in channel 9 metres less 0.5 metre plus rise of tide.
NAMIBIA, Nov 25 - Walvis Bay - Working normally.

SOUTH AFRICA, Nov 25 - Richards Bay - General cargo berths working normally but congestion expected next week, delays of approx 24-48 hours. Bulk import/bulk export working normally. Bulk coal berths, 4-5 days berthing delay, 10 vessels anchored, 2 due, congestion expected to continue until beginning of December. Durban - Container terminal, delays up to 78 hours. Point/New Pier/Maydon wharf berths, general cargo working normally. Maize terminal, 1 sunflower loader for December. Citrus terminal closed 1/11. Bunker supplies, delays of up to 4-6 hours in supplying of bunkers due to bunching of vessels. Drydock and floating dock booked for November and December.

East London - General cargo/combi terminal berths busy but no delays. Drydock fully booked for November and December. Copper moving in small parcels in containers to Far East. Gas oil pipeline under-utilised. Tankers expect to be busy until end-December. Port Elizabeth - Four vessels in port. No delays on general, tanker, ore or container berths. Container berth, 2 vessels due daily, no delays expected. Cape Town - breakbulk berths, no delays expected for coming week. No delays expected at container terminal. Bunker berths, no delays. Saldanha Bay - working normally.

TUNISIA, Nov 23 - Tunis - One vessel awaiting instructions, 1 discharging woodpulp. Rades - One discharging containers, 2 ro/ro, 1 discharging steel coils. Goulette - North side, 1 passenger vessel, 1 vessel discharging maize, 1 general cargo. South side, 1 discharging grain, 1 loading zinc concentrates, 1 in roads. Sfax - Three vessels operating of which 1 each discharging general cargo, timber, 1 loading bulk rock phosphate. Sousse - No vessels in port, no waiting time, no vessels waiting. Nov 25 - Bizerta - Three vessels operating of which 1 discharging rice, 1 discharging clay, 1 loading cement. No delay/congestion. Zarzis - No vessels, no delay/congestion.

UNITED ARAB EMIRATES, Nov 23 - Dubai - Vessels operating 11/11-23/11, 78 container vessels, 16 general cargo, 1 general cargo/container, 2 bulk carriers, 6 car carriers, 19 tankers, 4 naval vessels, 1 UAE naval, 1 bunkers/repairs/stores, 1 dhow, 15 barges, 11 tugs, 12 supply boats, 3 LPG tankers, 1 passenger, 1 crane barge, 1 vlcc, 1 bulk/oil, 1 self-propelled barge.

YEMEN, Nov 24 - Hodeidah - Three vessels berthed of which 1 rice/general, 1 flour, 1 general. 1 Vessel anchored awaiting berth berthing. Delays, 2 days for bagged cargo, 3 days for bulk wheat/corn, no delays for containers, reefers, general cargo. Hodeidah - Berths 2, 3, 7 are occupied. All other berths are vacant. Vessels alongside, 1 wheat flour, 1 general cargo/containers. Vessels anchored, 1 general cargo, 1 for loading berthing. Waiting time general cargo, containers up to 1 day, bagged cargo up to 2 days, bulk cargo up to 4 days. Mokha - One vessel discharging wheat flour alongside. No vessels anchored, no berthing waiting time. Public holiday 30/11.
